messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
Amber uses
make test.serial
make test.parallel
make trest.cuda
etc.
Is there a test suite for openMP versions of the code?
I am rebuilding amber22 on my server which is  RHEL 8.6 with AMD EPYC CPUs -
128 threads.
Any help would be appreciated.
Jim Kress

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Nov 13, 2022, James Kress via AMBER wrote:
>
>Amber uses
>
>make test.serial
>make test.parallel
>make trest.cuda
>etc.
>
>Is there a test suite for openMP versions of the code?
I think openMP is pretty much invisible to the outside code, so you could
use the ordinary tests.  But don't expect much: cpptraj is the main code
that could benefit from openMP.  There is some support in pmemd, but I think
it is rarely used -- most folks either use MPI or GPU acceleration.  Maybe
others on the list can offer more insights here.
>
>I am rebuilding amber22 on my server which is  RHEL 8.6 with AMD EPYC CPUs -
>128 threads.
This *ought* to be an environment where MPI shines with pmemd.  I'm getting
a similar setup soon, and will look at timings.
....dac
